vocab.cn_meaning: 夫妻;情侣;（有共同目的的）两个人
vocab.example: a married couple
vocab.cn_example: 一对夫妻

vocab.definition: a child of your aunt or uncle
vocab.cn_meaning: 堂（或表）兄弟;堂（或表）姐妹;远房亲戚
vocab.example: My brother's wife and I both had babies around the same time, so the cousins are very close in age.
vocab.cn_example: 我嫂子和我差不多同时生了孩子，因此这对表兄妹年纪相仿。

vocab.definition: stylish and attractive
vocab.example: an elegant woman
vocab.cn_example: 举止优雅的女性

vocab.definition: an agreement to be married
vocab.example: They announced their engagement at the party on Saturday.
vocab.cn_example: 他们在周六的聚会上宣布了他们订婚的消息。

vocab.definition: it will continue for an endless amount of time
vocab.example: I like the house but I don't imagine I'll live there forever.
vocab.cn_example: 我喜欢那栋房子，但是我想我不会在那里永远住下去。

vocab.definition: a woman with whom someone is in a romantic relationship
vocab.example: I've never met his girlfriend.
vocab.cn_example: 我从没见过他的女友。

vocab.definition: a long, formal dress that a woman wears for a special event
vocab.cn_meaning: （尤指正式场合穿的）女式礼服
vocab.example: a hospital gown
vocab.cn_example: 病号服

vocab.definition: to touch the lips or face of another person with your lips
vocab.example: There was a young couple on the sofa, kissing passionately.
vocab.cn_example: 沙发上一对年轻人正在热烈地接吻。

vocab.definition: to legally become a husband or wife of someone
vocab.example: Men tend to marry later than women.
vocab.cn_example: 男性成婚往往晚于女性。

vocab.definition: cheerful and lively
vocab.example: You got a bit merry last night, didn't you Cath?
vocab.cn_example: 你昨晚有点醉了，是吧，卡瑟？

vocab.definition: the son of your brother or sister
vocab.example: He entrusted the task to his nephew.
vocab.cn_example: 他把这任务托付给了他的侄儿。

vocab.definition: a social event where people enjoy themselves
vocab.example: a birthday party
vocab.cn_example: 生日聚会

vocab.definition: a girl or woman who has the same parents as you
vocab.example: Sophie and Emily are sisters.
vocab.cn_example: 索菲和埃米莉是姐妹。

vocab.definition: the son of your stepmother or stepfather
vocab.example: I've suddenly acquired a stepbrother.
vocab.cn_example: 我突然有了一个继兄弟。

vocab.definition: having the color of fresh snow or milk
vocab.example: In some countries it is traditional for a bride to wear white.
vocab.cn_example: 在某些国家的传统中，新娘要穿白色礼服。

vocab.definition: being part of the traditions of a country or group of people
vocab.example: Most bosses are traditional.
vocab.cn_example: 大多数老板都很传统。

vocab.definition: to give someone something and receive the same kind of thing from them
vocab.example: Shares soared on the New York stock exchange.
vocab.cn_example: 纽约证券交易所股票暴涨。

vocab.definition: a time for eating
vocab.example: The meal was amazingly cheap.
vocab.cn_example: 这餐饭便宜得出奇。

vocab.definition: a piece of jewelry that you wear around your wrist
vocab.example: Her bracelet was set with emeralds.
vocab.cn_example: 她的手镯上镶有绿宝石。

vocab.definition: a pattern sewn onto cloth, or cloth with patterns sewn onto it
vocab.example: She learned sewing, knitting, and embroidery.
vocab.cn_example: 她学过缝纫、编织和刺绣。

vocab.definition: very old
vocab.example: She has two rather aged aunts.
vocab.cn_example: 她有两位年迈的姑姑。

vocab.definition: a day on which an important event happened in a previous year
vocab.example: We always celebrate our wedding anniversary with dinner in an expensive restaurant.
vocab.cn_example: 我们总是去豪华饭店就餐来庆祝我们的结婚纪念日。

vocab.definition: happening once a year
vocab.example: an annual event/visit/holiday
vocab.cn_example: 年度大事／每年一次的访问／每年的假期

vocab.definition: someone with whom you spend a lot of time or go somewhere
vocab.example: The dog has been her constant companion these past ten years.
vocab.cn_example: 在过去的这10年里，这条狗一直与她形影不离。

vocab.definition: the ending of a marriage by a legal process
vocab.example: She's divorcing her husband.
vocab.cn_example: 她正在和丈夫闹离婚。

vocab.definition: very special, unusual, or strange
vocab.cn_meaning: 非凡的；特别的；意想不到的；令人惊奇的
vocab.example: He told the extraordinary story of his escape.
vocab.cn_example: 他讲述了他离奇的逃亡经历。

vocab.definition: the father of your husband or wife
vocab.example: He had been deeply affected by the sudden death of his father-in-law.
vocab.cn_example: 他深受其岳父突然辞世的影响。

vocab.definition: the state of being male or female
vocab.example: Latin nouns have case, number and gender.
vocab.cn_example: 拉丁语名词有格、数和性。

vocab.definition: parent of your mother or father
vocab.example: Almost every grandparent wants to be with his or her grandchildren and is willing to make sacrifices.
vocab.cn_example: 几乎每个祖父母都想和孙辈在一起，并愿意为他们做出牺牲。

vocab.definition: to put your arms around someone
vocab.cn_meaning: 拥抱，搂抱（以示喜欢或欣赏）
vocab.example: The road hugs the coast for several miles, then turns inland.
vocab.cn_example: 那条路有几英里紧靠着海岸，然后转向内陆。

vocab.definition: a relationship between a husband and a wife
vocab.example: They had a long and happy marriage.
vocab.cn_example: 他们的婚姻长久而幸福。

vocab.definition: recently born
vocab.example: Breast-feeding is extremely beneficial to the health of newborn babies.
vocab.cn_example: 母乳喂养对新生儿的健康极有益处。

vocab.definition: the daughter of your brother or sister
vocab.example: He looked affectionately at his niece.
vocab.cn_example: 他慈爱地看着他的侄女。

vocab.definition: not mixed with anything else
vocab.example: a pure cotton shirt
vocab.cn_example: 纯棉衬衣

vocab.definition: to say that you will not accept something
vocab.example: He asked me to give him another loan, but I refused.
vocab.cn_example: 他让我再借给他一笔钱，我拒绝了。

vocab.definition: to make something known
vocab.example: He was jailed for revealing secrets to the Russians.
vocab.cn_example: 他因为向俄国人泄密而被监禁。

vocab.definition: to search or try to find something
vocab.cn_meaning: 寻找；寻求（尤指非物质的东西）
vocab.example: "Are you actively seeking jobs?" she asked.
vocab.cn_example: “你在积极地找工作吗？”她问。

vocab.definition: a husband or a wife
vocab.example: In 60 percent of the households surveyed both spouses went out to work.
vocab.cn_example: 在60%的被调查家庭中，夫妻双方都外出工作。

vocab.definition: one of two babies that are born at the same time to the same mother
vocab.example: My sister has twin sons.
vocab.cn_example: 我姐姐有对双胞胎的儿子。

vocab.definition: a woman whose husband has died
vocab.example: He was widowed at the age of 52.
vocab.cn_example: 他52岁时妻子去世。

vocab.definition: a meeting of a group of people
vocab.example: We will be exploring different approaches to gathering information.
vocab.cn_example: 我们将探索收集信息的不同方法。

vocab.definition: to meet someone who you know, when you were not expecting to
vocab.example: If you bump into somebody, immediately say "Excuse me".
vocab.cn_example: 若不小心碰撞到别人，立即说“对不起。”

vocab.definition: not easy to work with
vocab.example: The exam was quite difficult.
vocab.cn_example: 这场考试相当难。

vocab.definition: an animal a family keeps and takes care of
vocab.example: They had had their pet dog stuffed.
vocab.cn_example: 他们请人把他们的宠物狗制成了标本。

vocab.definition: correct
vocab.example: It's not rubbish—it's true!
vocab.cn_example: 这不是瞎说—是真的！
